newsitem.title: USA: Intel Corp rises ahead of earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Intel Corp rises ahead of earnings report.

text.p: Shares of Intel Corp moved higher on Monday, recovering somewhat from stiff losses on Friday, ahead of the release of the semiconductor chip maker's first quarter earnings.

Shares rose 2-1/2 to 133 in late afternoon trading on the Nasdaq. On Friday, they tumbled 6-3/4 to 130-1/2 on worries over the company's upcoming earnings as well as concerns that a series of upcoming price cuts would slow its momentum.
The company is due to release earnings after the market close at 1600 EDT/2000 GMT.
First Call put analysts' consensus estimates for first quarter profits at $2.07. But traders said a "whisper number" of $2.15 to $2.20 is floating around Wall Street.

The stock, which has fell roughly 11 percent in the last three trading sessions of last week, was also upgraded earlier on Monday by Lehman Brothers analyst Michael Gumport. He raised first quarter estimates to $2.08 from $2 a share.
Wall Street will be on full alert for the earnings because bellwether Intel has made a recent habit of re-energizing flagging technology stocks with upbeat earnings reports.
